children: Hyster-Yale shares slumped after the company said it plans to offer $125 million worth of convertible senior notes due 2031.
Shares fell 29% to $18.48 on Wednesday. The stock is down 36% year to date.
The manufacturer of handling equipment said it intends to use the offering's proceeds to repay $100 million of the $213.2 million under its term loan agreement dated May 28, 2021.
Hyster-Yale also plans to use the notes to repurchase up to $15 million shares of its stock, to pay the cost of capped call transactions and for other general corporate purposes.
